title: Telling known people from the rest, by 6 months
summary: Most children know familiar people by about 6 months, the milestone sheet says.
body: Knowing the people who are already in the child's life is the whole of this 6-month line. sheet does not describe a quiz for how that knowing shows. Laughing, and liking a reflection, sit beside it as other lines. The leaflet's majority rule is three quarters or more, and it is not a substitute for a standardized screen. Only the US chart is used.

sources.title: Milestones by 6 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US government public domain. Supports the social/emotional milestone 'Knows familiar people'.
